breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core physical contradiction. The generated specification still asks to calculate terminal velocity while assuming the drag force is negligible. This is the exact error from the original prompt. The ground truth corrects this by providing the full formula that balances drag force against weight and buoyancy, which is the correct way to determine terminal velocity. The agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction instead of fixing it.
